leftEvidence.title: The assembly weeps and proposes a return to Egypt

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: The whole assembly cries through the night, complains against Moses and Aaron, and asks why the LORD brought them to die.
points.right: Moses challenges Reuben and Gad for discouraging Israel from crossing and retells the mission from Kadesh Barnea.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: They say wives and children will become prey and propose appointing a leader to return to Egypt.
points.right: He recalls the LORD’s anger, the excluded generation, Caleb and Joshua’s full following, and warns against renewing that failure.

payload.posture: Moses uses the earlier discouraging report to test whether Reuben and Gad will discourage Israel again.

rightEvidence.title: Moses warns the next generation by recalling the spies

payload.tension: The new land-allotment proposal is compared with the earlier crisis without being declared the same event.
payload.title: A refusal becomes a warning to the next generation
